definitions.explanation: A visual design or decorative pattern, especially one created for applied arts such as textiles, stamps, ceramics, or graphic design. Can also refer to the preliminary sketch or blueprint for such a design.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図案|ずあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think up a design for a postage stamp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図案|ずあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The design for the new banknote was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{和|わ}{柄|がら}→和柄：29241_wagara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{図案|ずあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧、⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I created a design based on a traditional Japanese pattern and used it for kimono fabric.

notes:
USAGE: {図案|ずあん} refers to decorative or applied design rather than engineering drawings or architectural plans. It is commonly associated with stamps, currency, textiles, and craft arts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図案|ずあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to create a design, to draw up a pattern
- {図案|ずあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think up a design
- ⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図案|ずあん}: stamp design
- {図案|ずあん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stylize into a design

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {図案|ずあん}: decorative design or pattern (applied arts)
- ⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: design (broad, modern usage)
- ⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: pattern (the pattern itself, not the act of designing)
- ⟦{意匠|いしょう}→意匠：12689_ishou⟧: design (legal/formal term, as in industrial design)
